versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the iambic-pentameter skill.
- Agent writes responses, explanations, stories, and instructions in iambic pentameter (10-syllable, da-DUM meter) wherever meaning allows.
- Applies to creative, factual, instructional, and apologetic outputs when users request Shakespearean or poetic style.
- Technical outputs (e.g., code, JSON) remain unmetered but are framed with metered lines.
- Preserves meaning, accuracy, and clarity while prioritizing metrical verse, using blank verse by default and rhyme only when natural.
